name: 찌리리공
wear: The spherical red upper half and white lower half become smoothly curved red upper-body plates and white hip and leg armor with a narrow black equatorial trim line. Angular eye shapes become small black chevron markings on the shoulder plates. Human woman, no ball costume, no central button, no handheld orb.
scene: On a deserted white ceramic power-station terrace under overcast daylight, stable front-facing standing card pose, both empty hands relaxed open outside silhouette, full head and feet visible.
casual: On an empty red-clay tennis practice court at dawn, taking a controlled lateral warm-up step with knees flexed and both empty hands open for balance; tennis net and white court lines, no racket.
Opaque white racerback athletic crop top with secure red underband, red high-waisted pleated tennis skort over opaque shorts, white trainers, bare arms midriff and legs; small red-white ear studs.

Inside a quiet vintage radio restoration workshop on a rainy afternoon, standing behind a bench and presenting an unlabeled small rectangular radio with both hands supporting its opposite ends; old speakers and amber bench lamp behind.
Opaque red sleeveless collared short waistcoat with secure button closure, white high-waisted wide-leg trousers below crop, bare arms shoulders and narrow midriff gap; tiny angular silver hair clip.

Inside a private minimalist apartment dressing alcove at blue hour, seated on a thick ivory floor cushion with knees bent naturally to one side and a slight torso twist, sorting two satin ribbons in her open hands over her lap; soft red lamp, mirror without reflected people.

Opaque fully lined white satin longline bralette with secure broad straps and red seam piping, red high-waisted tap shorts, short translucent dressing cape resting behind shoulders; chest and pelvis fully covered, bare arms shoulders midriff and legs. Lingerie-inspired fashion editorial.
